title: Webb Watch 956 is climbing: 1,038 hits today, 11,551 since launch
excerpt: Webb Watch 956 recorded 1,038 hits today and 11,551 since launch on Oct. 19, 2026 — thank you for reading and riding with us.
content:
Webb Watch 956 is climbing! The site recorded 1,038 hits today and 11,551 since launch, as of 9:29 a.m. on Saturday, Oct. 24, 2026.

Webb Watch 956 launched on Oct. 19, 2026, and in less than a week has grown into a daily stop for Webb County and the surrounding region — local news, police blotter coverage, Nuevo Laredo, elections, and stories from beyond the 956, in English and Spanish.

Thank you for tuning in, reading, and riding with us — all vibes, all day.

Keep reading at webbwatch956.com, and follow the page to stay in the know.

Sources: Webb Watch 956 site traffic, Oct. 24, 2026.
